blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Synthetic data is increasingly used in language-model pretraining. Existing knowledge-corpus synthesis pipelines, including WRAP and Nemotron-CC, usually take a source passage or document segment as input and generate rewritten or QA-style samples from that text. This can improve surface form and prompt diversity, but it does not explicitly require fine-grained source facts -- especially secondary entities, list/table entries, and precise temporal attributes -- to appear in the synthesized corpus. We propose AFCS (Atomic-Fact-Conditioned Synthesis), a pipeline that first extracts source-supported atomic facts and then uses each retained fact to drive generation. AFCS uses structure-aware extraction over the document tree, source-grounded verification, local context expansion, and multi-format generation. In continued-pretraining experiments with OLMo-3-7B and a 32B base on the same FineWiki source corpus, AFCS outperforms WRAP and Nemotron-CC on SimpleQA, SimpleQA Verified, PopQA, and HotpotQA. Granularity ablations show that fact-level synthesis improves over chunk-level, paragraph-level, and entity-level synthesis; and a 100B-token mid-training integration improves factual benchmarks and raises the 12-task general benchmark average by +1.09.
blocks.zh: 合成数据越来越多地用于语言模型预训. 现有的知识公司合成管道,包括WRAP和Nemotron-CC,通常采用源通道或文件段作为输入,并从该文本中生成重写或QA式样品. 这可以改善表面形态和迅速的多样性,但它没有明确要求在综合体中出现精细的源事实 -- -- 特别是二级实体、列表/表格条目和准确的时间属性。 我们提出AFCS(原子-事实-条件合成),这个管道首先提取源支持的原子事实,然后利用每个保留的事实驱动生成. 亚化安论坛在文件树上采用结构感知提取,源头验证,局部环境扩展,多格式生成. 在与OLMo-3-7B和基于同一FineWiki源体的32B的继续预训实验中,AFCS在SimpleQA,SimpleQA验证,PopQA,和HotototQA上的表现优于WRAP和Nemotron-CC. 外观分解表明,事实层次的合成在块级、段级和实体层次的合成上有所改进;100B-token中级培训集成改进了事实基准,将12项任务的一般基准平均数提高了1.09。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Synthetic data has become a common component of recent language-model pretraining recipes. WRAP and Nemotron-CC transform source passages or document segments into rewritten, QA-style, and knowledge-focused outputs ( Maini et al., 2024 ; Su et al., 2025 ) . Broader pretraining recipes also incorporate synthetic textbooks, question–answer pairs, instructions, exercises, and structured reasoning data ( Abdin et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025a ) . Together, these approaches expose knowledge through diverse textual forms during pretraining.
blocks.zh: 合成数据已经成为了近代语言模型预训配方的共同组成部分. WRAP和Nemotron-CC将源段落或文件部分转换为重写、QA型和以知识为重点的产出(Maini等,2024;Su等,2025)。 更广泛的预训配方还包括合成教科书、问答对等、指令、练习和结构化推理数据(Abdin等,2024;Yang等,2025a)。 这些方法一起在预训期间通过各种文字形式暴露知识。

blocks.en: Most knowledge-corpus synthesis methods take a source text unit as input. WRAP rewrites a source passage into multiple styles ( Maini et al., 2024 ) , while Nemotron-CC applies a multi-prompt mixture to document segments ( Su et al., 2025 ) . These methods differ in output format, but they share a common interface: a passage, segment, or document is given to the generator, which then produces synthetic samples from that input.
blocks.zh: 大多数知识-公司合成方法将源文本单元作为输入. WRAP将源代码重写为多样式(Maini等,2024年),而Nemotron-CC则对文件片段采用多速混合(Su等,2025年). 这些方法在输出格式上各有不同,但它们共享一个共同的界面:一个通道,段,或文件被交给生成器,生成器再从该输入中产生合成样本.

blocks.en: This work studies a fact-coverage issue that arises under this interface. Source-conditioned generation often preserves salient entities and headline events, but may omit secondary entities, list entries, table rows, and fine-grained dates. We treat this as a data-construction problem rather than as a ground-truth coverage metric: diagnostic extraction and matching are used to identify recurring omission patterns, while the continued-pretraining experiments provide the main evidence for whether the resulting synthetic data improves model behavior.
blocks.zh: 这项工作研究了在这一界面下出现的事实覆盖问题。 以源为条件的生成经常会保留显著的实体和头条事件,但可能会省略次要实体,列出条目,表格行,并细细地标明日期. 我们将此视为一个数据构建问题,而不是一个地面真实覆盖的衡量标准:诊断提取和匹配用于识别反复出现的遗漏模式,而持续的预演实验则为由此产生的合成数据是否改善了模型行为提供了主要证据.

blocks.en: We propose Atomic-Fact-Conditioned Synthesis (AFCS) . AFCS changes the driver of data synthesis. Instead of using a source text unit alone as the generation prompt, AFCS first extracts source-supported atomic facts, expands the local context when needed, and generates samples conditioned on retained facts selected for synthesis. AFCS targets explicit fact coverage in the synthetic corpus; its effect on model behavior is evaluated through downstream continued-pretraining experiments.
blocks.zh: 我们提出原子-事实-条件合成。 AFCS改变数据合成的驱动程序. 亚化安论坛不单使用源文本单位作为生成的提示,而是首先取出源支持的原子事实,在需要时扩展本地上下文,生成以所选合成的留存事实为条件的样本. 化安论坛的目标是在合成体中明确涵盖事实;它对于模型行为的影响通过下游持续预训实验进行评估。

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: 1. We show that source-conditioned knowledge-corpus synthesis can omit many fine-grained facts that are present in the source, especially for secondary entities, list/table entries, and fine-grained temporal attributes. 2. We introduce AFCS as a coverage-oriented data-construction interface that turns extracted, source-supported assertions into explicit generation targets through structure-aware extraction, source-grounded verification, local context expansion, and multi-format generation. 3. We evaluate AFCS on OLMo-3-7B ( Team OLMo et al., 2025 ) and a 32B base using the same FineWiki source corpus ( Penedo, 2025 ) as the baselines. AFCS improves middle- and long-tail factual recall on PopQA. 4. Through granularity and mechanism ablations, we show that fact-level conditioning outperforms coarser units; targeted mechanism contrasts yield results consistent with benefits from broader fact coverage, repeated realizations per fact, and multi-format generation.
blocks.zh: 我们的捐款如下: 1. 我们显示,以源为条件的知识-公司合成可以省略来源中存在的许多精细分量的事实,特别是二级实体、清单/表项和精细分量的时间属性。 2. 我们采用非洲化安论坛作为面向覆盖的数据建设接口,通过结构感知提取、源头支持的断言、源头验证、本地环境扩展和多形式生成,将提取的数据、源头支持的断言转化为明确的生成目标。 3. 我们以OLMo-3-7B(Team OLMo等,2025年)和一个使用同为基线的FineWiki源码(Penedo,2025年)的32B基数评估AFCS。 AFCS在PopQA上改进了中长尾实录. 4. 通过颗粒性和机制活化,我们显示,事实层面的调节优于合力单位;目标机制与更广泛的事实覆盖、每个事实的重复实现和多形式生成的惠益形成对比。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Continued pretraining on domain-specific corpora is a standard way to adapt language models ( Gururangan et al., 2020 ) . Recent pretraining recipes increasingly use synthetic data to improve the presentation of raw text: WRAP paraphrasing rewrites web passages into cleaner QA or expository forms ( Maini et al., 2024 ) , Nemotron-CC applies a multi-prompt mixture to Common Crawl segments ( Su et al., 2025 ) , and other systems use genre reformulation and active reading ( Hao et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2025 ) . Web-corpus construction work such as FineWeb and DCLM studies filtering, deduplication, and source-quality trade-offs at scale ( Penedo et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024 ) . These works focus on source quality, surface form, and corpus-scale construction. AFCS addresses a narrower interface question: for a fixed source corpus, how should source facts be selected as synthetic-data targets before they are realized in text?
blocks.zh: 继续针对域特异性corpora进行预训是适应语言模型的标准方法(Gururangan等,2020年). 最近的培训前配方越来越多地使用合成数据来改进原始文本的表达方式:WRAP paraphrasing将网页段落重写为更清洁的QA或说明形式(Maini等,2024年),Nemotron-CC对常见克勞克分片(Su等,2025年)采用多速分混合物,而其他系统则采用流派再生和活取读取(Hao等,2025年;Lin等,2025年). FineWeb和DCLM等Web-corpus建筑工程研究了过滤,分解,以及规模化的源质量取舍(Penedo等,2024;Li等,2024.). 这些工程侧重于源质量、地表形态和体积建筑。 化安论坛处理一个较狭义的界面问题:对于一个固定源体,如何在文本实现之前将源事实选作合成数据目标?

blocks.en: Most existing synthesis pipelines condition generation on a passage, document segment, or whole article. Prompt diversity can broaden the forms in which a document is studied, and structure-preserving paraphrasing can maintain label fidelity, but the generator still decides which source facts to mention. Active Reading similarly broadens document-conditioned study through model-proposed strategies including paraphrasing, knowledge linking, active recall, and analogical reasoning ( Lin et al., 2025 ) . These approaches increase the diversity of views or actions applied to a source document, but they do not make source-fact selection explicit before generation. This creates a fact-selection bottleneck: salient entities and headline events are likely to be preserved, while secondary entities, list entries, table rows, and precise dates may be omitted. AFCS changes this interface by extracting source-grounded facts before generation and assigning generation attempts to those facts. The distinction is not the use of QA or rewriting formats, but whether fact selection remains implicit in a source-text prompt or is made explicit before surface realization.
blocks.zh: 大多数现有合成管道都以通道、文件段或整条作为生成条件。 即时多样性可以拓宽研究文件的形式,结构保留拓扑可以保持标签的忠诚性,但生成者仍然决定要提及哪一个来源的事实. 积极阅读同样通过示范性拟议战略,包括拓扑、知识联系、积极召回和模拟推理(Lin等,2025年)。 这些方法增加了适用于源文件的观点或行动的多样性,但并不使源事实选择在生成前明确. 这就造成了一个事实选择瓶颈:突出的实体和头条事件有可能被保留,而次要实体,列表条目,表格行,以及准确的日期可能被省略. 化安论坛通过在生成之前提取来源依据的事实,并给这些事实分配生成尝试,来改变这一界面. 区别不在于使用QA或重写格式,而在于事实选择是否仍然隐含在源文本提示中,或者在表面实现前被明确.

blocks.en: Web structure can provide intermediate signals for pretraining: Hyperlink-induced pretraining ( Zhou et al., 2022 ) uses hyperlink topology to construct pseudo query–passage pairs for retrieval. For synthetic continued pretraining, EntiGraph ( Yang et al., 2025b ) extracts entities and synthesizes from entity pairs or triples; Synthesize-on-Graph (SoG) ( Ma et al., 2025 ) builds a context graph and uses graph traversal followed by secondary sampling to construct cross-document generation contexts; Synthetic Bootstrapped Pretraining ( Yang et al., 2025c ) learns inter-document relations and synthesizes new corpora from those relations. Structured methods based on entities, attributes, relations, or graphs can represent many of the same facts targeted by AFCS, especially when qualifiers, reification, or schema extensions are allowed. We therefore do not view the distinction as one of theoretical representational capacity. Rather, AFCS makes fact selection explicit and source-local: each extracted, source-supported assertion is treated as a generation target, with its target value and evidence span available for realization. The anchor of such an assertion need not be a canonical entity; it can also be a table row, list item, section context, date, numerical value, or descriptive span. Several AFCS assertions encode negation, evidential absence, conditionality, or full-clause values that are not naturally represented as a single canonical entity–relation edge (Appendix B ). Entity- or graph-conditioned methods typically provide entities, attributes, profiles, relation edges, or graph paths as synthesis context, leaving the generator or graph-walk procedure to determine which facts are ultimately realized in text. Our matched-budget entity-level ablation provides one comparison with a coarser conditioning unit and yields lower scores than conditioning on explicit fact-value assertions in our setting. In different knowledge-injection settings, Mecklenburg et al.’s fact-based scaling pipeline ( Mecklenburg et al., 2024 ) constructs QA pairs from extracted atomic facts, while Knowledge-Instruct ( Ovadia et al., 2025 ) constructs instruction data from entity-anchored facts.
blocks.zh: Web结构可以为预训提供中间信号:Hyperlink-由Hyperlink-引發的预训(周等,2022年)使用超链接地理学来构建伪查询-通道对以进行检索. 对于合成持续预试,EntiGraph(杨等,2025年b)从实体对或三重体中取出实体并合成; Synthesize-on-Graph(SOG)(马等,2025年)构建上下文图并使用图转录后再进行二次采样来构建跨文件生成背景; Synthetic Bootstrapped Pretraining(杨等,2025年c)从这些关系中学习到文件间关系并合成出新的蝎子. 基于实体,属性,关系或图表的结构化方法可以代表AFCS针对的许多相同的事实,特别是在允许修饰,再化,或计划扩展时. 因此,我们不认为这种区别是理论上的代表能力。 相反,化安论坛将事实选择明确和源地化:每个提取的、源地支持的断言都被视为一代目标,其目标价值和证据跨度可供实现。 这种断言的主干不一定是一个犬科实体;它也可以是一个表格行、列表项目、章节上下文、日期、数值或描述性跨度。 AFCS的几个断言编码否定、证据缺失、附加条件或完全声明值,这些都不是自然代表的单一舟体实体-关系边缘(附录B)。 实体-或图表条件化的方法通常提供实体,属性,剖面,关系边缘,或图表路径作为合成上下文,让生成器或图表行走程序决定哪些事实最终在文本中实现. 我们的对应预算实体层面的减值提供了一种与同轴器调节单元的比较,并得出比我们设定中明确的事实价值断言的分数更低的分数。 在不同的知识注入环境中,梅克伦堡等基于事实的缩放管道(梅克伦堡等,2024年)从所提取的原子事实中构建出QA对;而知识-指令(奥瓦迪亚等,2025年)则从实体-焦虑的事实中构建出指令数据.

blocks.en: SimpleQA evaluates short, fact-seeking questions with a single verifiable answer ( Wei et al., 2024 ) . We use factual QA benchmarks to compare model behavior before and after continued pretraining. Broad benchmarks such as MMLU measure general knowledge and reasoning across many domains ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) . In this work, SimpleQA and SimpleQA Verified ( Wei et al., 2024 ; Haas et al., 2025 ) , PopQA ( Mallen et al., 2023 ) , and HotpotQA ( Yang et al., 2018 ) measure factual QA behavior, while a separate source-fact coverage diagnostic evaluates the synthetic corpus and the 12-task mid-training suite checks broader capability compatibility. This separation is important because explicit source-fact coverage does not automatically imply that every covered fact is stored or retrieved by the trained model.
blocks.zh: 简单 QA以单一可核实的答案评价简短的,求真问题(Wei等,2024. 我们使用真实的QA基准来比较模式行为在继续预训前后. MMLU等宽泛的基准衡量了许多领域的一般知识和推理(Hendrycks等,2021年)。 在这部作品中,SimpleQA和SimpleQA验证(Wei等,2024;Haas等,2025;PopQA(Mallen等,2023;HotpotQA(Yang等,2018))测量了真实的QA行为,而单独的源活性覆盖诊断则评价了人工合成体和12任务中培训套件检查更广泛的能力相容性. 这种分离很重要,因为明确的源事实覆盖并不自动意味着每个被覆盖的事实都由经过训练的模型存储或检索.

blocks.en: ROME ( Meng et al., 2022 ) edits individual factual associations, while MEMIT ( Meng et al., 2023 ) directly edits many factual memories in model parameters; neither is a corpus-scale pretraining method. RAG ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) combines parametric generation with an external non-parametric memory at inference time, while REPLUG ( Shi et al., 2024 ) motivates retrieval as access to the long tail of knowledge that a parametric model may not represent. AFCS instead changes the pretraining corpus, while retrieval-augmented methods remain complementary for deployment-time access to external evidence.
blocks.zh: ROME(Meng等,2022年)编辑了个别事实协会,而MEMIT(Meng等,2023年)则直接编辑了模型参数中的许多事实记忆;两者都不是实体尺度的预训方法. RAG(Lewis等,2020年)在推想时间将参数生成与外部非参数内存结合,而REPLUG(Shi等,2024年)则将检索作为获取参数模型可能不代表的长尾知识的动力. 反之,非洲化安论坛修改了培训前程序,而检索强化方法仍然是部署时间获取外部证据的补充。

blocks.en: 3 Problem Formulation: Source-Fact Coverage
blocks.zh: 3 问题表述:来源-事实覆盖

blocks.en: 3.1 Atomic Facts
blocks.zh: 3.1 原子事实

blocks.en: Let 𝒟 = { d 1 , … , d N } \mathcal{D}=\{d_{1},\dots,d_{N}\} be a knowledge corpus. For a source unit d d , let ℱ ⁡ ( d ) = { f 1 , … , f n d } \mathcal{F}(d)=\{f_{1},\dots,f_{n_{d}}\} denote the atomic facts expressed in that unit. We use atomic fact to mean a minimal source-supported assertion that can be verified against a local evidence span. The unit is not required to be centered on a canonical entity or to correspond to a canonical entity–relation edge. Some records are anchored by named entities, while others are anchored by a table row, list item, section context, date, numerical value, or descriptive span. In implementation, records are stored in a subject–predicate–value-like form for convenience, but the subject can be a local anchor rather than a canonical entity, and the predicate or value may contain free-form natural language. Each record contains a target value and a source span that supports it. Appendix B gives examples of assertions that use this notation but are not intended as canonical KG triples.

blocks.en: A synthesis algorithm maps either a source unit or an extracted fact set to training samples. We say a sample covers a fact when it explicitly states the fact value with enough local context to identify the relevant entity or attribute. This notion describes the source-fact selection problem; the paper’s main model-performance claims are based on downstream continued-pretraining results, with coverage reported separately as a data-side diagnostic.
blocks.zh: 合成算法绘制出一个源单位或提取出的事实集来训练样品. 我们说,一个样本涵盖了一个事实,它明确说明了事实价值,并有足够的本地背景来确认相关的实体或属性。 这一概念描述了来源-事实选择问题;该文件的主要模式-绩效索赔依据的是下游继续培训的结果,其覆盖面作为数据侧诊断单独报告。

blocks.en: 3.2 Source-Conditioned Synthesis
blocks.zh: 3.2 有源条件的综合

blocks.en: Prior synthesis methods can be organized by their conditioning unit. WRAP ( Maini et al., 2024 ) produces prompted rewrites from source passages or paragraph-level examples, including QA-style and stylistic paraphrase outputs. Nemotron-CC ( Su et al., 2025 ) defines five prompt types for document segments with prompt-specific token limits, including knowledge extraction, distillation, diverse QA pairs, knowledge lists, and Wikipedia-style rewriting.

blocks.en: These pipelines can produce fluent and diverse text, but they do not directly specify which fine-grained source facts must be expressed. The generator receives a source unit and produces synthetic samples from it. We call this family source-conditioned synthesis. AFCS instead uses atomic-fact-conditioned synthesis: an extractor first identifies atomic facts, and generation is conditioned on retained facts selected for synthesis, with source context available for realization.
blocks.zh: 这些管线可以产生流利而多样的文字,但是它们并没有直接规定哪些精细的源性事实必须表达. 发电机接收出一个源单元,并从中产生合成样品. 我们称之为家源性合成。 反之,AFCS使用原子-事实条件合成:一个提取器首先识别原子事实,而生成是以所选择的用于合成的保留事实为条件的,有源上下文可供实现.

blocks.en: 3.3 Omission Patterns
blocks.zh: 3.3 排放模式

blocks.en: We separate missing source evidence from omissions introduced by synthesis; the SimpleQA Verified source-availability funnel is reported in Appendix F . The main text focuses on source facts that are present in the corpus but are not explicitly realized by source-conditioned synthesis.
blocks.zh: 我们把缺失源证据与合成引入的遗漏分开;附录F中报告了SimpleQA验证源可用性漏斗。 主文侧重于本体中存在但因来源条件综合而未明确实现的来源事实.

blocks.en: Author inspection of 200 uncovered facts from the source-conditioned pipeline shows three recurring omission patterns. First, secondary entities—including people, organizations, and locations mentioned relatively infrequently within an article—are often omitted. Second, list- and table-embedded facts are under-covered: a QA generator may ask about an award as a whole while omitting individual year–recipient rows. Third, temporal facts are often coarsened, for example from month/day precision to year-level statements.
blocks.zh: 作者对从源头条件下的管道中发现的200起事实的检查表明,有三种重复出现的遗漏模式。 首先,在一条条款中很少提到次要实体,包括人员、组织和地点。 第二,列表和表格中包含的事实被掩盖不足:一个QA生成者可能询问整个奖项,而省略了单个年份的收奖行. 第三,时间性事实经常被收缩,例如从月/日的精确到年级的报表.

blocks.en: Figure 1: AFCS pipeline and source-fact coverage. Source-conditioned synthesis (top) segments the web corpus and asks an LLM to synthesize from each segment, so the generated corpus tends to preserve salient facts while under-covering fine-grained facts in lists, tables, and secondary mentions. Atomic-fact-conditioned synthesis (bottom) first extracts structure-aware atomic facts from the same source corpus and then conditions generation on source-anchored assertion cards. Each card marks the local anchor (e.g., a document scope, list item, table row, or date cell), the natural-language assertion, and the highlighted value structure (e.g., a role binding, multi-element set, compound clause, or bibliographic record). These cards are generation targets rather than canonical entity–relation KG triples.
blocks.zh: 图1:非洲化安论坛管道和源事实覆盖。 以源为条件的合成(上)将网络元件分出,要求一个LLM从每个元件中合成,因此生成的元件往往会保留显著的事实,同时在列表,表格和次要引用中未充分涵盖精细的事实. 原子-事实-条件合成(下方)首先从同源体中提取出结构-认识原子事实,再以来源-选择的断言卡作为生成条件. 每张卡片会标出本地主锚(如文档范围,列表项目,表格行,或日期单元格),自然语言断言,并标出突出值结构(如角色约束,多元素集,复合条款,或书目记录等). 这些卡片是生成目标,而不是犬科实体-关系KG 三相.

blocks.en: 4 Method: AFCS
blocks.zh: 4 方法:化安论坛

blocks.en: AFCS is an atomic-fact-conditioned synthesis pipeline (Figure 1 ). It extracts source-supported atomic facts, expands local context where needed, and generates training samples conditioned on extracted facts. This shifts fact selection upstream to extraction and verification, rather than leaving it entirely to the generator’s preference for salient source content.
blocks.zh: AFCS是一个原子-事实-条件合成管道(图1. 它提取来源支持的原子事实,在需要的地方扩展本地环境,并生成以所取事实为条件的训练样本. 这把对事实的选择转移到上游,取出和核实,而不是完全留给生成者倾向于显著的源内容。

blocks.en: 4.1 Atomic Fact Extraction
blocks.zh: 4.1 原子事实提取

blocks.en: Wikipedia pages have a natural document tree, including title, sections, paragraphs, lists, tables, and infoboxes. AFCS uses this structure during extraction. Tables, lists, numeric-heavy content, and prose are processed with separate prompt templates (Appendix D ). Extraction statistics and author-checked precision/recall are reported in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 维基百科页面有天然文档树,包括标题,章节,段落,列表,表格,以及信息箱等. AFCS在取出时使用这种结构. 表格,列表,数字-重度内容,以及取名词用单独的即时模板(Appendix D.)处理. 附录A报告了采掘统计数据和作者核对的准确性/召回情况。

blocks.en: As defined in § 3.1 , an atomic fact is a source-supported assertion with a target value and local evidence span, not necessarily a canonical entity-centered record. AFCS represents dates, numerical attributes, aliases, list entries, table rows, and descriptive properties as typed atomic facts, without requiring a strict tuple schema. An AFCS unit is assertion-centric rather than entity-centric: it contains the statement to be realized, its target value, and the local evidence span used for verification and realization. Thus, entity attributes are not merely exposed as part of an entity profile; each attribute-value assertion can become an independent synthesis target. The same representation also covers non-canonical assertions such as evidential absence, conditional statements, causal explanations, reported speech, and full-clause values. When a fact depends on nearby context, AFCS expands the visible context around the focal span. When the fact spans related sections, those sections are opened while unrelated sections remain closed. The synthesis unit remains the extracted assertion or evidence span rather than the whole article.
blocks.zh: 如第3.1节所定义,原子事实是一种来源支持的主张,具有目标值和当地证据跨度,不一定是以犬科实体为中心的记录. AFCS代表日期,数字属性,别名,列表条目,表格行,以及描述性作为打出原子事实,而不需要严格的tuple schema. 化安论坛的一个单位以断言为中心,而不是以实体为中心:它包含有待实现的声明、目标价值以及用于核查和实现的当地证据范围。 因此,实体属性不只是作为实体概况的一部分被暴露出来;每个属性-值断言都可以成为一个独立的合成目标. 同样的表述还涵盖非无稽之谈,如证据缺失、有条件陈述、因果关系解释、报告的言论和全部声明价值。 当一个事实取决于附近的上下文时,AFCS会在焦距周围扩展可见上下文. 当事实跨越相关科室时,这些科室会打开,而无关科室则仍然关闭。 合成单元仍然是所提取的断言或证据所跨的范围,而不是整个条款。

blocks.en: 4.2 Source-Grounded Verification
blocks.zh: 4.2 源头核查

blocks.en: The extracted records are checked against their source spans before synthesis. This step filters out records whose values are judged unsupported by the verifier and preserves the source offset used for later context expansion. The verifier is not intended to produce a complete factual database. Its role is to reduce unsupported facts before they are amplified into multiple synthetic samples.
blocks.zh: 取出的记录在合成之前要对照其出处进行核对。 此步骤过滤出其值被验证者判断为不支持的记录并保留用于后上下文扩展的源抵消. 核查者无意建立一个完整的事实数据库。 它的作用是在被放大成多份合成样品之前减少无根据的事实.

blocks.en: 4.3 Multi-Format Generation
blocks.zh: 4.3 多格式生成

blocks.en: For each retained fact f f selected for synthesis and its local context ctx ⁡ ( f ) \mathrm{ctx}(f) , AFCS generates complementary natural-language samples. All formats are driven by the extracted fact rather than by an unconstrained source-text prompt: • Summary : contextual summaries that preserve nearby factual relations and ordering. • Rewrite : paraphrases in alternative registers while preserving the same factual sequence. • Continuation : continuations from a local prefix that must include the target fact. • QA : answer-guided question generation. The value of the extracted fact is supplied as the target answer, and the generator writes natural questions whose answer is that value.
blocks.zh: 对于每个保留的事实f f 用于合成及其局部上下文 ctx → (f)\mathrm{ctx} (f),AFCS生成互补的自然语言样本. 所有格式都由提取的事实驱动,而不是由不受限制的源文本提示来驱动: • 摘要:保存附近事实关系和秩序的背景摘要. • 改写:在保留相同事实序列的同时,在备选登记册中作解释。 • 继续:从当地前缀继续,其中必须包括目标事实。 • 质量保证:回答指导问题生成。 取出的事实的价值作为目标答案提供,生成者写出自然问题,其答案就是这个价值.

blocks.en: Summary : contextual summaries that preserve nearby factual relations and ordering.
blocks.zh: 摘要:保存附近事实关系和秩序的背景摘要.

blocks.en: Rewrite : paraphrases in alternative registers while preserving the same factual sequence.
blocks.zh: 改写:在保留相同事实顺序的同时,在备选登记册中作解释。

blocks.en: Continuation : continuations from a local prefix that must include the target fact.
blocks.zh: 续:从本地前缀中取出必须包含目标事实的续作.

blocks.en: QA : answer-guided question generation. The value of the extracted fact is supplied as the target answer, and the generator writes natural questions whose answer is that value.
blocks.zh: QA:答案-导出问题生成. 取出的事实的价值作为目标答案提供,生成者写出自然问题,其答案就是这个价值.

blocks.zh: 各种格式的样本数量和象征性数量分布见附录C。

blocks.en: 4.4 Corpus-Scale Construction
blocks.zh: 4.4 公司规模建筑

blocks.en: We instantiate AFCS on approximately 6.7M FineWiki articles. Structure-aware extraction produces 312.7M atomic facts, with 34.9% from prose, 29.2% from tables or infoboxes, 19.6% from numeric attributes, and 16.3% from lists. The resulting AFCS corpus contains 142M natural-language synthesized samples across four formats. On a 500-article author-checked subset, extracted facts reach 94.1% precision and 87.6% recall; recall on list- and table-embedded facts is 82.4%, compared with 48.7% for a single-pass non-structure-aware extractor. These statistics characterize the scale and extraction quality of AFCS; comparative source-fact coverage is evaluated separately in Section 5.3 .
blocks.zh: 我们在大约6.7M FineWiki的文章上对AFCS进行即时分析. 结构感知取出出312.7M原子事实,34.9%取自活口,29.2%取自表格或信息箱,19.6%取自数字属性,16.3%取自列表. 由此形成的AFCS体包括142M个自然语言合成样本,它们有四种格式。 在500篇文章作者检查的子集中,提取的事实精确度达到94.1%,召回率达到87.6%;在列表和表格中列出的事实中召回率为82.4%,而单通非结构提取器的召回率为48.7%。 这些统计数字是化安论坛规模和取出质量的特点;第5.3节单独评价了比较源与事实的涵盖范围。

blocks.en: The AFCS extractor, source-grounded verifier, and synthetic-sample generator use the same instruction-tuned generator checkpoint, Qwen3-30B-A3B, served with vLLM. Extraction and verification use deterministic decoding (temperature 0), while multi-format generation uses temperature 0.7 with prompt-specific maximum output lengths. We filter records rejected by the source-grounded verifier and remove degenerate or condition-leaking generations. QA samples are deduplicated by exact question match, by fact id with at most two retained questions per fact, and by character-trigram overlap; multi-format outputs are deduplicated first by input span and then by output text. The final corpus contains 142M synthetic samples; the main 7B and 32B comparisons consume 20B packed training tokens from the corresponding synthetic corpus, and the mid-training integration uses 5B AFCS tokens. Data generation is a one-time offline inference cost separate from continued-pretraining compute.
blocks.zh: AFCS提取器,源底验证器,和合成-样本生成器使用相同的指令调制生成器检出点,即Qune3-30B-A3B,服务于vLLM. 采掘与核查使用定型解码(温度为0),而多格式生成使用温度为0.7,并有即时特定的最大输出长度. 我们过滤被源源源验证人拒绝的记录,并去除堕落的或处于状态的几代人. QA样本通过精确的问题匹配来分解,按每个事实最多保留了两个问题的事实id来分解,并按字符-图重叠来分解;多格式输出先被分解出输入跨度,再被分解出输出文本来分解. 最终体积包含142M合成样品;主7B和32B比较消耗了从相应的合成体中取出20B包装的训练符号,而训练中集成则使用5B AFCS符号. 数据生成是一种一次性的离线推断费用,与继续预训计算分开.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5个实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: All 7B methods continue training from OLMo-3-7B ( Team OLMo et al., 2025 ) (stage 1, step 1.4M), with optimizer state restored from the base checkpoint. We use AdamW ( β 1 = 0.9 , β 2 = 0.95 \beta_{1}{=}0.9,\beta_{2}{=}0.95 ), peak learning rate 2.07 × 10 − 5 2.07\times 10^{-5} , linear decay to 0, batch size 2M tokens, and sequence length 8192. Before packing, training samples are globally shuffled and then concatenated into fixed-length windows. Runs use the actual synthesized corpora produced by each method, with generated-token counts reported in Table 1 ; all main comparisons use a matched 20B-token continued-pretraining budget.
blocks.zh: 所有7B方法继续从OLMo-3-7B(Team OLMo等,2025年)(第1阶段,第1.4M步)进行训练,基地检查站恢复了最优化状态. 我们使用 AdamW(β 1 = 0.9,β 2 = 0.95\β 1\β0.9,\β → β 2\00.95),峰值学习率 2.07 × 10 − 5 2.07\times 10\^{-5},线性衰变为 0,批量大小 2M 个令牌,序列长度 8192. 在包装前,训练样品被全球洗涤后再被收缩入固定长的窗口. 运行使用由每种方法产生的实际合成的蝎子,生成子计数在表1中报告;所有主要比较使用匹配的20B-token持续预训预算.

blocks.en: All methods use the same FineWiki source corpus and the same base training recipe. Our WRAP baseline applies the four WRAP style prompts to each source passage or paragraph-level example ( Maini et al., 2024 ) . Our Nemotron-CC baseline reruns on FineWiki the five prompt types defined by Nemotron-CC ( Su et al., 2025 ) . AFCS uses multi-format samples generated from extracted atomic facts. For the granularity ablations, chunk- and paragraph-level synthesis use the same generator with only the conditioning unit changed, while the entity-level baseline first extracts canonical subject–predicate–value triples and then conditions generation on both the extracted triple and its corresponding source context.
blocks.zh: 所有方法都使用相同的FineWiki源代码和相同的基础训练配方. 我们的WRAP基线将四个WRAP风格的提示适用于每个源段落或段落级的例子(Maini等,2024年)。 我们的Nemotron-CC基线在FineWiki上重新运行了由Nemotron-CC(Su等,2025年)定义的5个即时类型. 化安论坛使用从所取原子事实中产生的多格式样品。 对于颗粒分解,块和段级合成使用同一个发生器,只有调节单元改变,而实体级基线首先提取出被提取的三相和相应的源上下文的canonical object-predicate-value 三相,然后条件生成。

Few-shot ICL is a standard way to evaluate pretrained base models without task-specific finetuning; here it probes factual acquisition and recoverability after continued pretraining. The specific prompting, inference, judging, sampling, and scoring settings are provided in Appendix G .

blocks.zh: 5.3 明确来源-事实覆盖

blocks.en: 5.4 Component Ablations
blocks.zh: 5.4 组件损坏

blocks.en: We ablate synthesis granularity and the mechanisms within AFCS on the 7B last checkpoint. The conditioning-unit block compares fact-level conditioning against coarser alternatives using the shared model and training/evaluation setup. In the entity variant, extraction is explicitly constrained to canonical subject–predicate–value triples; generation then receives the triple together with its source context, providing a matched-budget entity/triple-conditioned comparison with an alternative representation unit. We also adapt EntiGraph relation synthesis ( Yang et al., 2025b ) and the fact-to-QA pipeline of Mecklenburg et al. (2024) under the same 20B-token CPT budget and evaluation setup. The mechanism block provides matched-budget contrasts for output format, per-fact amplification, and fact coverage.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: 6.1 Why Synthesis Granularity Matters
blocks.zh: 6.1 请检查date=中的日期值 (帮助) 为什么合成颗粒性问题

blocks.en: The granularity rows in Table 4 show that fact-level conditioning is more effective than chunk-level, paragraph-level, or entity-level synthesis. Coarser units preserve local context, but they again leave the generator to select which fine-grained facts to express. Entity-level synthesis narrows the topic but still does not specify the relation or attribute that must be covered. Atomic facts provide a smaller and more explicit conditioning unit, making the target value directly visible while retaining enough source context for fluent realization.
blocks.zh: 表4中的颗粒性行显示,事实层面的调节比块层面,段落层面,或实体层面的合成更有效. 相干单位保存了本地上下文,但它们再次离开生成器,选择哪些精细的事实来表达. 实体级综合缩小了专题范围,但仍没有具体说明必须涵盖的关系或属性. 原子事实提供了一个更小而更明确的调节单元,使目标值直接可见,同时保留足够的源上下文来进行流畅的实现.

blocks.en: 6.2 Source-Conditioned Baselines
blocks.zh: 6.2 有源的基线

blocks.en: The comparison with WRAP and Nemotron-CC indicates that prompt diversity alone does not fully address fact selection. WRAP targets surface-form variation but yields smaller PopQA gains in our setup. Nemotron-CC performs well on average and on some popularity buckets, yet it still conditions generation on document segments rather than extracted facts. AFCS differs by making the target fact explicit before generation. The largest gains appear in the rare and middle-frequency PopQA buckets.
blocks.zh: 与WRAP和Nemotron-CC的比较表明,仅仅迅速多样化并不能完全解决事实选择问题。 WRAP针对地表形态的变异,但在我们的设置中产生较小的PopQA增益. Nemotron-CC平均表现良好,在一些受欢迎的桶上,但它仍然要求生成文件,而不是提取事实。 化安论坛通过在生成前明确目标事实而有所不同。 最大的收益出现在稀有和中频PopQA桶上.

blocks.en: 6.3 Coverage, Acquisition, and Scope
blocks.zh: 6.3 覆盖范围、获取和范围

blocks.en: Explicit source-fact coverage is a property of the synthesized corpus, whereas factual QA and pass@ k k measure model-side acquisition and recoverability after continued pretraining. The higher coverage and pass@ k k observed for AFCS provide consistent but indirect evidence across these two levels; they are not a one-to-one measurement that each covered fact is stored and retrieved. Accordingly, we interpret the corpus-coverage and model-performance measures as complementary rather than as establishing a causal link.
blocks.zh: 明确来源-事实覆盖是综合体的财产,而事实性质量保证和通过@kk度量模型-侧获取和在继续预先训练后可恢复性。 非洲化安论坛的覆盖率和通过率较高@kk为这两个级别提供了一致而间接的证据;它们不是储存和检索每个覆盖事实的一对一的衡量标准。 因此,我们把人身覆盖和模范业绩措施解释为互补措施,而不是建立因果关系。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We studied a coverage failure mode in knowledge-corpus synthesis: when generation is conditioned on a source passage or document segment, fine-grained facts present in the source may be omitted from the synthetic corpus. AFCS mitigates this issue by extracting atomic facts and using retained facts as generation targets. On FineWiki, AFCS improves factual QA performance at 7B and is strongest on middle-tail PopQA entities. Matched-budget granularity ablations show that fact-level conditioning outperforms coarser units, while targeted mechanism contrasts yield results consistent with benefits from broader fact coverage, repeated realizations per fact, and multi-format generation. The 32B results show that AFCS remains strongest among the synthetic-data methods across SimpleQA, SimpleQA Verified, PopQA, and HotpotQA. In a 100B-token OLMo-3 mid-training integration, AFCS improves factual QA benchmarks and raises the 12-task general benchmark average to 69.33. Future work includes stronger extraction verification, multilingual extension, and combining atomic-fact-conditioned synthesis with corpus filtering and retrieval.
blocks.zh: 我们研究了知识-公司合成中的覆盖失败模式:当生成以源段落或文件段为条件时,来源中的精细事实可能从合成体中省去. 化安论坛通过提取原子事实并使用所保留的事实作为生成目标来缓解这一问题. 在"FineWiki"上,AFCS在7B上改进了事实QA的性能,并最强于中尾PopQA实体. 相匹配的预算颗粒分解表明,事实水平的调制优于同位素单位,而目标机制则与更广泛的事实覆盖、每个事实的重复实现和多格式生成的效益相匹配。 32B的结果显示,AFCS仍然是SimpleQA,SimpleQA验证,PopQA,和HotpotQA等多个合成数据方法中最强的. 在100B-token OLMo-3培训中集成中,AFCS改进了实事求是的QA基准,将12项任务的一般基准平均值提高到69.33. 今后的工作包括加强提取核查、多语种扩展、将原子-事实合成与实体过滤和检索相结合。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: • Extractor dependence. AFCS depends on an LLM extractor and verifier. We report precision and recall on an author-checked subset, but residual extraction errors can propagate to synthetic samples. • Coverage versus learning. Explicit presence in the synthetic corpus does not guarantee that the trained model stores or retrieves a fact. • Scale. We evaluate 7B and 32B models. Whether the same trends persist at larger model scales remains open. • Domain. All experiments use English Wikipedia. Generalization to other languages and domains such as scientific literature, legal text, or code is untested. • Cost. AFCS requires structure-aware extraction, verification, and multi-format generation. This is a one-time data-construction cost and incurs additional offline inference at the multi-million-article scale. • Retrieval scope. AFCS changes pretraining data to improve parametric factual knowledge and does not compare against retrieval-augmented systems. The two approaches address different deployment trade-offs and may be combined in future work.
blocks.zh: • 抽取物依赖。 AFCS依赖于LLM提取器和验证器. 我们报告一个作者检查的子集的精确度和召回度,但残余取出错误可以传播给合成样本。 • 覆盖面与学习。 人工合成体中明确存在并不能保证经过培训的模型存储或取回一个事实。 • 规模。 我们评价7B和32B模型。 在较大的模型尺度上,同样的趋势是否继续存在,仍然没有定论。 • 领域。 所有实验都使用英语维基百科. 对科学文献,法律文本,或代码等其它语言和领域的通俗化没有经过测试. • 成本:化安论坛需要结构意识的提取、核查和多形式生成。 这是一项一次性数据建设费用,按数百万颗粒规模进行额外离线推断。 • 检索范围。 化安论坛改变预先培训数据,以改善参数化的事实知识,不与检索强化系统作比较。 这两种办法处理不同的部署取舍,并可在今后的工作中结合起来。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: Our training corpus is English Wikipedia, a publicly licensed knowledge resource. Atomic facts and synthesized samples inherit Wikipedia’s existing biases toward over-represented regions, languages, and demographic groups. AFCS may amplify facts present in the source corpus, including those biases. We do not perform additional debiasing or fact-checking beyond Wikipedia’s editorial process and our source-grounded verification step. Synthesized samples may still contain unsupported surface phrasing and should be used for pretraining research rather than as a standalone factual reference.

blocks.zh: AFCS使用单独的表格,列表,数字,和道具提取符提示. 模板中的braces表示运行时间替换;重复的即时示例被省略用于空间.

blocks.en: The no_struct ablation replaces the four structure-specific prompts with a single generic extractor. It is distinct from the natural prose-only document subset reported in Table 12 .
blocks.zh: no_struct ablext 将四个结构特异性导出替换为单一的通用取出器. 它不同于表12所汇报的自然唯利是图的文件子集。

blocks.en: The QA instruction is adapted from the QA-style prompt of WRAP ( Maini et al., 2024 ) , with the additional constraint that the answer is fixed to the value of an extracted fact rather than chosen by the generator.
blocks.zh: QA指令由WRAP(Maini等,2024年)的QA型快取(QA-system)所改编而来,附加的制约是答案固定在取出的事实的价值上,而不是由生成者选择.

blocks.en: The concrete multi-format prompt is used for the AFCS non-QA formats.
blocks.zh: 混凝土多格式快取用于AFCS非QA格式.

blocks.en: Chunk- and paragraph-level baselines call the same generator templates with the source chunk or paragraph as the conditioning input. The entity-level baseline uses a separate extractor prompt that explicitly asks for canonical subject–predicate–value triples only; its generator receives both the extracted triple and the corresponding local source context. This design provides an entity/triple-conditioned comparison, while AFCS conditions on source-anchored fact records that may include table rows, list items, dates, quantities, or full-clause values.
blocks.zh: Chunk-和段落级基线将源块或段落的同一生成器模板称为条件输入. 实体一级的基线使用单独的提取器提示器,明确要求只提供被提取的三重值;其生成器既接收被提取的三重值,也接收相应的本地源上下文。 这种设计提供了一种实体/三重条件比较,而AFCS关于来源性事实记录的条件,可能包括表格行,列表项目,日期,数量,或全声明值.

blocks.en: We adapt the two-stage passage-to-fact-to-QA structure of Mecklenburg et al. (2024) , including up to ten QA pairs per fact, optional SKIP for facts that are too broad or insufficiently specific, top- p p 0.95, and exact-match question deduplication. In our implementation, Qwen3-30B-A3B performs both stages with temperature 0.7 and a maximum of 1,500 output tokens per stage; exact duplicate questions are removed during packing. The prompt templates are reproduced below.
blocks.zh: 我们调整了梅克伦堡等人(2024年)的双相相通对QA结构,包括每个事实最多10个QA对,对过于宽泛或不够具体的事实的可选SKIP,上行-p.0.95,以及精确的相匹配问题分解. 在我们的实施中,Qune3-30B-A3B执行两个阶段,温度为0.7,每个阶段最多为1,500个输出符;包装时消除了确切的重复问题。 快速模板转载如下。

blocks.en: Table extractor Extract structured facts from this document. Output a JSON array only. The document is about: {title}. Each fact is one object: {‘‘subj’’:‘‘...’’, ‘‘pred’’:‘‘...’’, ‘‘val’’:‘‘...’’, ‘‘source_span’’:‘‘...’’}. Rules - Process every data row, including the final rows of long tables. For scorecard or statistics tables, extract every meaningful numeric column for every row. - For tables with three or more columns, use multi-direction extraction: rotate which meaningful column is the answer value and place the remaining columns in the subject or predicate as context. Always retain the most natural direction; add reverse directions for entity names, people, places, awards, teams, years, and dates, but not for purely numeric attributes whose reverse direction is unnatural. - For cast or crew entries, extract both actor-to-character and character-to-actor directions. - Also capture dense structured records expressed without explicit table markup, including entity attributes, biographical details, events, and discography items. - Preserve the exact supporting text in source_span; keep val concise. Return at most 500 facts. Start with [ and end with ]; output no other text. <document>{document_chunk}</document>
blocks.zh: 表格提取器 从本文件中提取结构化事实。 只输出 JSON 阵列 。 文件内容为:{title}. 每一个事实都是一个目标: {‘‘subj’’:‘‘. ’’. ’’. ’’. ’’. 规则 处理每个数据行,包括长表格的最后一行。 对于计分卡或统计表,取出每行每个有意义的数字栏. - 对于有3个或3个以上列的表格,使用多方向取出:旋转哪个有意义的列是答案值,并将所余列作为上下文放在主题或上游。 总是保留最自然的方向;为实体名称,人物,地点,奖项,团队,年份,和日期增加倒向方向,但不为反向方向不自然的纯粹数字属性. - 对于演员或摄制组的作品,既要从演员到演员,也要从角色到演员。 - 还记录未经明确表标的密集结构记录,包括实体属性、履历细节、事件和相片。 - 保留来源_span中的确切支持文本;保持Val简洁. 返回最多500个事实。 以[并用]开头;不输出其他文本。 < document_{document_chunk}/ document> (文档)

blocks.en: List extractor Extract list, award, and rank items from the document. Output a JSON array only. The document is about: {title}. Each entry is one object: {‘‘subj’’:‘‘...’’, ‘‘pred’’:‘‘qualifier’’, ‘‘val’’:‘‘entry name’’, ‘‘source_span’’:‘‘...’’}. Rules - Set subj to the entity described by the list, not to a generic category label such as ‘‘Awards’’ or ‘‘Works.’’ Produce one object per entry and per applicable direction; never merge entries. - For award/year lists, extract applicable recipient, year, and award-name directions so that each meaningful field can serve as the answer. Process every year, including early historical entries. - For cast or crew lists, extract every member in both actor-to-character and character-to-actor directions. - In Recognition, Awards, and Honors sections, extract all year--prize pairs and the corresponding recipient direction. Skip section headers and vague entries. - Preserve the exact supporting text in source_span. Return at most 500 facts. Start with [ and end with ]; output no other text. <document>{document_chunk}</document>
blocks.zh: 列表提取器 摘录文档中的列表,授予,和排序项目. 只输出 JSON 阵列 。 文件内容为:{title}. 每个条目都有一个对象: {‘‘(subj’’:‘‘.), ‘‘(pred’’:‘‘.), ‘‘(val’’.), ‘‘(val’’.), ’’(entry name), ‘‘(source_span’’:‘‘.). 规则 将子j设定为列表所描述的实体,而不是设置为“授标”或“工作”等通用类别标签。 每个条目和每个适用方向产生一个对象;从不合并条目。 - 奖项/年度名单,取出适用的受奖者、年度和奖名指示,以便每个有意义的领域都能作为答案。 每年的进程,包括早期的历史条目. - 对于演员或船员名单,从演员到演员和人物到演员的指挥中抽取每个成员。 - 在表彰、颁奖和荣誉等部门,摘录全年的配对和相应的受奖方向。 跳过区域标题和模糊条目 。 - 保留来源_span中的确切支持文本。 返回最多500个事实。 以[并用]开头;不输出其他文本。 < document_{document_chunk}/ document> (文档)

blocks.en: Numeric extractor Extract all dates, counts, measurements, rankings, codes, and product specifications from the document. The document is about: {title}. For each item, output {‘‘subj’’:‘‘...’’, ‘‘pred’’:‘‘...’’, ‘‘val’’:‘‘...’’, ‘‘source_span’’:‘‘...’’}. Rules - Use the specific entity described by the number, date, or code as subj. Prefer exact, question-answerable values and skip approximate or vague numbers. - Extract years from recognition, award, and honor lists even when they appear in list format. - For month--year and full-date mentions, emit both the full-granularity value and the year; for year-only mentions, emit one fact. Preserve exact counts and measurements without embedding explanatory phrases in val. - Include secondary-event dates such as publication, appointment, certification, release, performance, competition, interview, statement, and speech dates. - Include product codes, model identifiers, standards, serial or edition numbers, and exact small counts. Output only a valid JSON array. <document>{document_chunk}</document>
blocks.zh: 数字提取器 从文档中提取出所有日期、计数、测量、排名、代码和产品规格。 文件内容为:{title}. 每一项目,产出: +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ 规则 使用由数字,日期或代码描述的特定实体作为子j. 偏好精确,可回答的值并跳过相近或模糊的数字. - 从表彰、奖励和荣誉名单中提取年份,即使这些名单以名单格式出现。 - 对于每月和全年的提法,既要发出全方位值,也要发出全年;对于只提到一年,要发出一个事实。 在val中不嵌入解释性短语的情况下保留精确的计数和测量. - 包括次要活动日期,如出版、任命、认证、发布、表演、竞争、面试、声明和演讲日期。 - 包括产品代码、模型识别符、标准、序列号或版号,以及精确的小数。 只输出一个有效的 JSON 阵列 。 < document_{document_chunk}/ document> (文档)

blocks.en: Prose extractor Extract (subject, predicate, value) facts from the document prose. The document is about: {title}. Focus on entity relationships, biographical details, events, and attributions. For each fact, output subj, pred, val (the answer), and source_span (exact supporting text). Output only a JSON array and aim for completeness. Rules - Use a specific named entity as subj; never use vague references such as ‘‘the author’’ or ‘‘the subject.’’ Prefer facts that support specific, unambiguous questions rather than general descriptions. - Pay particular attention to appointment or nomination, competition or defeat, creation or authorship, replacement or succession, marriage or partnership, aliases, membership, event locations, requesters or initiators, education, and dated interviews or statements. - For role portrayals, extract both actor-to-character and character-to-actor directions. For passive constructions such as ‘‘X was appointed by Y,’’ set subj=X, pred=‘‘appointed by,’’ and val=Y. <document>{document_chunk}</document>
blocks.zh: 亲子提取器 从文件中提取(主体,上游,价值)事实. 文件内容为:{title}. 注重实体关系,传记细节,事件,归属. 对于每个事实,输出subj, pred, val( 答案), 和 source_ span( 确切的支持文本) 。 只输出 JSON 阵列并瞄准完整性 。 规则 使用特定的被命名实体作为子j; 绝不使用模糊的引用, 如 {作者} 或 {主题}。} 倾向于支持具体、明确问题的事实,而不是笼统的描述。 - 特别注意任命或提名、竞争或失败、创建或撰写、替换或继承、婚姻或伴侣关系、别名、成员、活动地点、请求者或发起人、教育以及日期访谈或声明。 - 对于角色描写,要同时取出演员对角色和人物对角色的方向. 对于被动构造,例如由 Y 指定 , + 指定 subj , 由 + 和 val= Y 指定 。 < document * document_ chunk */ document>

blocks.en: Generic no-structure mode Extract all factual information from the document as (subject, predicate, value) facts. The document is about: {title}. Be comprehensive: include entities, dates, numbers, list items, and table values. For each fact, output subj, pred, val, and the exact source_span. Use a specific named entity as the subject and focus on facts that can form specific, unambiguous questions. Output only a JSON array. <document>{document_chunk}</document>
blocks.zh: 取出文件中作为(主题、上游、价值)事实的所有事实资料。 文件内容为:{title}. 内容全面:包括实体、日期、数字、清单项目和表值。 对于每个事实,输出subj, pred, val, 以及准确的源_ span. 使用特定被命名的实体作为主体,并关注能够形成具体,明确问题的事实. 只输出一个 JSON 阵列。 < document_% document_ chunk_%/ document>

blocks.en: Source-grounded verifier You will receive a source context and an extracted fact record: (anchor, predicate_or_attribute, value, span). Decide whether the value is directly supported by the source context. Requirements - Use only the provided context. - If supported, output {"verdict":"SUPPORTED", "normalized_value":"..."}. - If unsupported, output {"verdict":"UNSUPPORTED", "reason":"..."}. - If the context is insufficient, output {"verdict":"NOT_FOUND"}. Output Return JSON only.
blocks.zh: 源码验证器 您将收到源上下文和提取的事实记录 :( 锁定、 上游属性、 值、 跨度 ) 。 决定该值是否由源上下文直接支持. 要求 - 只使用已提供上下文 。 - 如果支持, 输出 { "核查" : “ SUPPORTED ” , “ 正常值” : “... ”) 。 - 如果不支持, 输出 { “ 核查” : “ UNUPPORTED ” , “ 理由” : “... ”) 。 - 如果上下文不足, 输出 { “ 核查” : “ NOT_ FOUND ” ) 。 仅输出返回JSON。

blocks.en: AFCS answer-guided QA synthesis For EACH fact below, generate 1--2 question--answer pairs. The answer is fixed to the value of the extracted fact. Use the local source context as primary evidence, including the source span and any section-level breadcrumb needed to make the question specific. Rules 1. The question must be answerable from the local context or the document. 2. Write natural questions; avoid overly formal forms such as ‘‘Presupposing that ...’’. 3. Do not create tautological QA where the question merely restates the answer. 4. Match question type to answer type: person names use Who; dates/years use When or What year; numbers use How many or How much; places use Where. 5. For list or table facts, include the year, row, position, institution, award, or other qualifier needed to identify the exact row/item. 6. Preserve temporal granularity: if the answer is a full date, ask for the full date; if it is month plus year, ask for month and year; if it is a year, include enough event context to avoid ambiguity. 7. If several facts in the batch have similar predicates but different answers, make each question discriminative by adding the subject name or another distinguishing qualifier. 8. Do not include the answer verbatim inside the question. Output Return JSON only: [{‘‘fact_id’’:‘‘...’’, ‘‘question’’:‘‘...’’, ‘‘answer’’:‘‘...’’}].
blocks.zh: AFCS 答案指南QA综合 对于下面的EACH事实,生成1-2个问答对. 答案与被取出的事实的价值是固定的. 使用当地来源背景作为主要证据,包括来源跨度和使问题具体化所需的任何分层面包屑. 规则 1. 问题必须从当地情况或文件中回答。 2. 写出自然问题;避免过于正式的形式,如 .假设.。 3. 在问题只是重述答案的情况下,不要创造双重QA。 4. 将问题类型与回答类型相匹配:人名使用Who;日期/年份使用When或What年;数字使用多少或多少;地点使用Where. 5. 对于清单或表格中的事实,包括年份、行、职位、机构、奖项,或确定确切行/项目所需的其他限定词。 6. 保留时间颗粒性:如果答案是完整的日期,则要求完整的日期;如果是月份加年份,则要求月份和年份;如果是一年,则包含足够的事件上下文来避免模糊. 7. 如果批次中的几个事实具有相似的上游但不同的答案,则通过增加主题名称或另一个区分限定词,使每个问题具有歧视性。 8. 问题中不包括逐字回答。 返回输出 JSON只:[{‘‘事实:‘‘. ’’. ’’. ‘‘.

blocks.en: AFCS multi-format synthesis For each fact below, generate ONE training data sample in the best non-QA format. Use the document context and the fact fields subj, pred, val, fact_type, and local_context. Available formats 1. summary: {‘‘fact_id’’:‘‘...’’, ‘‘output_type’’:‘‘summary’’, ‘‘input_text’’:‘‘...’’, ‘‘summary’’:‘‘...’’}. 2. rewrite: {‘‘fact_id’’:‘‘...’’, ‘‘output_type’’:‘‘rewrite’’, ‘‘original’’:‘‘...’’, ‘‘rewritten’’:‘‘...’’, ‘‘style’’:‘‘simplified|formal|paraphrase’’}. 3. continuation: {‘‘fact_id’’:‘‘...’’, ‘‘output_type’’:‘‘continuation’’, ‘‘prefix’’:‘‘...’’, ‘‘continuation’’:‘‘...’’}. Output Return JSON only. Each output must express the target fact and remain supported by the provided local context.

Fact-QA stage 1: passage-to-fact Please break down the following snippet from the Wikipedia article titled ‘‘[THEME]’’ into atomic facts. Goal 1: The atomic facts should be as simple as possible, if it’s compound sentence, break down one more time. Goal 2: For clarity, avoid using pronouns like ‘‘it’’, ‘‘he’’, ‘‘she’’, ‘‘this’’, ‘‘that’’ etc., and instead use the full names or titles. [PASSAGE] 1.
blocks.zh: 事实-QA阶段1:通过与事实 请将维基百科中题为"[THEME]"的文章中的以下片段细分为原子事实. 目标1:原子事实应该尽可能简单,如果是复合句子,就再破一次. 目标2:为明确起见,应避免使用 " ‘‘ " 、 " ‘‘ " 、 " she " 、 " ‘‘ " 、 " ’’ " 等代名词,取而代之的是使用全名或全名。 [评论] 1.

blocks.en: Fact-QA stage 2: fact-to-QA Write 10 pairs of questions and answers probing the facts and statistics of a given sentence about [THEME]. Consider first generating questions and answers that are very relevant and explicit to the fact, then paraphrase those questions and answers to reach the desired 10 Q&A pairs. If the fact is too broad or not specific enough to [THEME], you may reply with SKIP and be done. EXAMPLE: FACT: 14 million viewers tuned in to the opening game of the series. 1. Q: How many viewers watched the first game? A: 14 million people watched the first game of the series. EXAMPLE: FACT: The rose is red. SKIP FACT: [FACT] 1.
blocks.zh: 事实质量评估阶段2:事实质量评估 写出10对问答,探究某句关于[THEME]的事实和统计. 考虑首先产生与事实非常相关和明确的问题和答案,然后解释这些问题和答案,以达到期望的10个QQA对. 如果事实过于宽泛或不具体到[THEME],您可以向SKIP回复并完成. EXAMPLE:FACT:有1400万观众收看该系列的开局游戏. 1. 问:有多少观众观看了第一场比赛? A:1400万人观看了系列的第一作. (原始内容存档于2017-10-21). EXAMPLE: FACT:玫瑰为红色. [事实] 1. 联合国

blocks.en: Appendix E Source-Fact Coverage Evaluation
blocks.zh: 附录E 来源-事实覆盖评价

blocks.en: We use gpt-oss-120b ( OpenAI, 2025 ) as the coverage judge. For each evaluated source-supported fact, the judge receives the synthetic data derived from the corresponding source document and determines whether the fact is explicitly covered. The diagnostic is run on 600K data instances; each instance pairs a reference fact with the method-specific synthetic outputs derived from the same source document. Each reference fact is represented by its subject, relation, value, source sentence, and section path.
blocks.zh: 我们使用gpt-oss-120b(OpenAI,2025)作为覆盖裁判. 对于每个被评价的源支持的事实,法官接收从相应源文件得到的合成数据,并判断该事实是否明确涵盖. 诊断在600K数据实例上运行;每个实例与同一源文档中得出的特定方法合成输出对一参考事实. 每个参考事实由它的主题,关系,价值,源句,和节路径来表示.

blocks.en: A fact is marked as covered only when the exact claim, including its value, precision, and attribution, is recoverable from the synthetic text. Coverage is the proportion of evaluated facts judged covered. An author review of 100 judgments gives 96% agreement with the automatic judge. This metric evaluates explicit coverage in the synthetic corpus rather than model acquisition.
blocks.zh: 只有从合成文本中可以收回确切的索赔要求,包括其价值、精确度和归属性,才标出所涉事实。 覆盖范围是评估的事实被判定覆盖的比例。 作者对100项判决的审查使96%同意自动法官。 这一衡量标准评估的是合成体的明确涵盖范围,而不是模型获取。

blocks.en: We identify 3,102,410 documents indexed by this diagnostic as natural prose-only sources and recompute coverage within this subset. This is a subset analysis rather than a rerun that removes structure from the same documents. AFCS remains above WRAP and Nemotron-CC within the prose-only subset, including the fact-dense group.
blocks.zh: 我们确定3,102,410份由这种诊断索引的文件是天然的唯亲来源,并在此子集内重新计算覆盖率。 这是一个子集分析,而不是从同一个文档中去掉结构的再运行. 亚化安论坛仍位于WRAP和Nematron-CC之上,属于只传教的子集,包括真相小组。

blocks.zh: 表12:天然唯亲子集的源信息覆盖率(%)。 全文件的《化安论坛》一栏作为参考,而不是作为结构迁移干预。

blocks.en: The system and user messages are reproduced verbatim below; %%CTX%% and %%FACTS%% are the runtime placeholders for the document-specific synthetic text and numbered fact blocks.
blocks.zh: 该系统和用户信息逐字转载如下: " CTQ " 和 " FACTS " 是特定文件合成文本和编号事实块的运行时间占位符。

blocks.en: Coverage-judge prompt System: You are a precise fact-checking assistant. User: You are a STRICT fact-checking judge. You are given SYNTHETIC TEXT rewritten/derived from a Wikipedia article, and a NUMBERED LIST of atomic facts drawn from that same article. Each fact is shown as subject / relation / value, plus the original source sentence it came from (and its section). Treat these together as ONE assertion---the claim the source sentence makes. Judge whether that whole claim is covered; do NOT just match the subject/relation/value strings as separate slots. The source sentence tells you what the claim actually means (the raw subject/relation/value may be terse or awkwardly worded---rely on the source sentence to understand the true assertion). Decide COVERED only when the SYNTHETIC TEXT would let a reader RECOVER THE EXACT CLAIM. Apply these rules strictly: COVERED requires ALL of: 1. The specific value (the who/what/when/how-much of the claim) is EXPLICITLY present in the synthetic text---not implied, not inferable, not "close". 2. It is UNAMBIGUOUSLY ATTRIBUTED to the right entity/attribute, so a reader can tell this value belongs to THIS claim and not something adjacent. 3. Numbers, dates, scores, percentages, quantities, and proper names match EXACTLY. No rounding, no approximation, no unit/precision loss. NOT COVERED (be strict---when in doubt, choose NOT COVERED) if ANY of: - the value is missing, only alluded to, or requires inference/world-knowledge to reconstruct; - ANY loss of precision: a full date rendered as year-only (or vice-versa); an exact number/score/percentage rendered as "several"/"many"/"about"/rounded/a range; a specific award/item/rank/table-row replaced by its general category; - the entity is mentioned but this particular attribute/value is not; - the value only appears inside a bare structured fragment or list with no context tying it to the entity (a value that merely "shows up" among enumerated items does NOT count unless the text clearly asserts it OF the entity); - the attribution is uncertain or could plausibly belong to a different entity. Paraphrasing and reordering are fine ONLY if the exact value and its attribution both survive. SYNTHETIC TEXT: """ %%CTX%% """ FACTS: %%FACTS%% Output a JSON array, one object per fact, SAME ORDER, using the Fact number as id: [{"id":1,"covered":true},{"id":2,"covered":false}, ...]

blocks.en: For SimpleQA, SimpleQA Verified, PopQA, and HotpotQA, we use a 5-shot prompt with the format Question: ...\n Answer: ... . We do not use retrieval. Each benchmark is evaluated with the same three-stage pipeline: 1. Inference : the model generates an answer under the specified decoding setting. 2. Judge : Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct assigns one of CORRECT , INCORRECT , or NOT_ATTEMPTED . 3. Score : accuracy is the proportion of examples judged CORRECT ; INCORRECT and NOT_ATTEMPTED are both counted as non-correct. For pass@1, we use temperature 0 and greedy decoding. For sampled pass@ k k with k > 1 k>1 , we use temperature 0.6 and top- p = 0.95 p=0.95 ; a question is counted as correct if any of the k k sampled answers is judged CORRECT .
